candidates.requirement: Permit a second nonfinal XML_Parse on the same parser after an incomplete token so the supported deferred retry behavior is reachable.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates each parser; ParseOneInput calls XML_Parse once with isFinal=0 and once with isFinal=1; XML_Parse reaches XML_ParseBuffer and callProcessor.
candidates.failure_condition: A finite supported setup such as an incomplete attribute token followed by a short nonfinal continuation can defer reparsing. No fuzzer input changes the target's second call from final to nonfinal.
candidates.alternative_paths: The final call bypasses deferral, each child is newly initialized, and the target has no resume or additional parse call. These routes do not exercise deferred nonfinal retry.

candidates.requirement: Allow the parser's supported deferral setting to be disabled for nonfinal parsing and inherited by a child parser.
candidates.target_route: The entry creates a parent parser, parses it, then creates two external-entity parsers that inherit its setting; ParseOneInput configures handlers and hash salt but never deferral.
candidates.failure_condition: With a valid parser and XML_FALSE, XML_SetReparseDeferralEnabled succeeds and changes nonfinal partial-token behavior. The target always uses the enabled default and never passes XML_FALSE to the setter.
candidates.alternative_paths: XML bytes do not change this parser field, and a final parse bypasses the heuristic without selecting the disabled setting or demonstrating its inheritance.

before.requirement: Reach a deferred retry on a later nonfinal continuation after an incomplete token.
before.reason: The before ParseBuffer calls the processor directly; the deferral helper is absent from the verified preimage.

source_evidence.quote: Verified preimage file expat/lib/xmlparse.c has no function definition named callProcessor. The entire after definition consists of added lines. This establishes absence in this file only; other implementations or equivalent paths must still be considered.

after.requirement: Reach a deferred retry on a later nonfinal continuation after an incomplete token.
after.reason: ParseBuffer now calls the deferral helper, but the harness makes only one nonfinal XML_Parse call per parser.

claims.reason: The same deferred-retry tuple is absent before and supported but unreachable after; no preexisting defect is substituted.

before.requirement: Create an external-entity child inheriting disabled reparse deferral from its parent.
before.reason: The before child-creation function has no deferral setting to copy, and the setter is absent from the verified preimage.

source_evidence.quote: Verified preimage file expat/lib/xmlparse.c has no function definition named XML_SetReparseDeferralEnabled. The entire after definition consists of added lines. This establishes absence in this file only; other implementations or equivalent paths must still be considered.

after.requirement: Create an external-entity child inheriting disabled reparse deferral from its parent.
after.reason: The setter accepts XML_FALSE and child creation copies the parent setting; the harness creates children without calling the setter.

source_evidence.quote:
Large tokens may require many parse calls before enough data is available for Expat to parse it in full. If Expat retried parsing the token on every parse call, parsing could take quadratic time. To avoid this, Expat only retries once a significant amount of new data is available. This function allows disabling this behavior.

The enabled argument should be XML_TRUE or XML_FALSE.

Returns XML_TRUE on success, and XML_FALSE on error.

claims.reason: The same child-inheritance tuple is unavailable before and supported but unreachable after; the setter is a prerequisite of that tuple.
